findings.proposed: {others, plural, one {# autre} many {# d’autres} other {# autres}}
findings.detail: French CLDR has a `many` category (exact multiples of 10^6) and the fr guide's plural example carries it; 279 of 283 fr plural messages in this corpus do. Without it 1 000 000 renders '1 000 000 autres' where French writes 'd’autres' after a million. Unreachable for a reaction count in practice, so recorded, not gating.
findings.disposition: recorded; translator/implementer may apply the proposed string
